root_cause.detail: seal_bundle.py called frozen.parse_and_formula_hash from the historical UF20 helper, which asserts header==(20,91). UF250_020 is correctly (250,1065), so sealing aborted before candidate execution.
root_cause.traceback_terminal: AssertionError at assert header==(20,91) and len(clauses)==91

authorized_repair.with: local strict UF250 parser requiring p cnf 250 1065 and exactly 1065 canonical 3-CNF clauses, computing the same canonical clause-sequence SHA-256 used by the frozen UF250 evaluator

rerun_policy: Update workflow only to bind the repaired sealer blob, then let the same push-triggered gate rerun. The failed run is infrastructure/implementation evidence only.
